comparison.objective: Place a swing-top stopper and snap its wire bail over centre to seal a bottle; candidate configures a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a free bottle, guide a linked stopper, and actuate an over-centre linkage versus driver/wrench seating, countertorque, and stop adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper aligned, lever past centre with stretched link, bottle upright, hands released, and full state stable for one second; candidate instead verifies retained opening through three cycles.
comparison.reason: The record tests linked stopper placement and over-centre closure mechanics, not coupled screw-and-locknut calibration.
